info.title: AdvocateMate API
info.description: Backend for the AdvocateMate Andhra Pradesh High Court advocate app. Court data is retrieved server-side from public APHC sources (aphc.gov.in Hcdbs pages and the Lexika chatbot). These /api/v1 routes are AdvocateMate's own API, not APHC endpoints.

post.summary: Step 1: verify a Google ID token on the server
post.description:
Returns a session straight away when this Google account is already linked to an eligible
advocate (Scenario B); otherwise `advocate_code_required` with a short-lived link token.

post.summary: Step 2: link the verified Google account to an advocate code (automatic registry check)
